objective: Create an implementation-ready plan to migrate a production IPsec VPN from IKEv1 to IKEv2 with minimal service risk.
constraints: No live network changes may be executed by the benchmark
authoritative_context: The benchmark contains no live device state
All implementation details must remain proposals

objective: Turn an ambiguous request for AI-assisted task planning into a bounded implementation contract for a coding agent.
requirements: Prevent model output from directly mutating canonical state
constraints: Do not assume a particular model provider
authoritative_context: The coding agent may only modify approved repository paths

objective: Convert an unclear cross-team infrastructure initiative into accountable delegation without the manager absorbing team ownership.
requirements: Identify assumptions that require stakeholder confirmation
constraints: The manager retains accountability but should not perform subordinate work
No employee motives may be inferred
authoritative_context: The initiative crosses engineering and operations teams

objective: Produce a decision brief from conflicting technical sources while preserving uncertainty and provenance.
constraints: Do not cite sources not supplied in the scenario
authoritative_context: Two primary sources disagree on a material implementation constraint
A secondary source summarizes both but is outdated

objective: Translate a policy requiring approved production changes into practical technical and operating controls.
constraints: Controls must be proportionate to consequence
authoritative_context: The organization already has identity and change-ticket systems
The policy text does not define implementation technology

objective: Create a time-bounded response plan for a simulated service outage without allowing documentation overhead to delay containment.
constraints: The initial response plan must be usable within ten minutes
No destructive action may be assumed authorized
authoritative_context: Monitoring indicates customer impact but the root cause is unknown
